title: Original Shipping Refunded According to Return Reason
content:
When a Returns & Exchanges return refunded to the original card or wallet comes back because of a fault, part or all of the original shipping is refunded with it. The share follows the reasons on the return's authorization entries.

## Shipping share

| Reasons on the return's authorization entries | Share of the original shipping refunded |
|---|---|
| Any line returned as defective or as arrived too late | 1 — the whole |
| No such line, but a line returned as not as pictured | 0.5 — half |
| Any other return | Nothing |

## Original shipping refund

The original shipping refund is the shipping fee refunded for the order's delivery service, times the shipping basis (the part of the order the return takes back), times this share, rounded half up to the cent; the rounding is applied with a tolerance of 0.0001 cent, so an amount on a half cent goes up. The original shipping refund is added to the amount paid to the card, which with it remains no more than what is refundable on that card.

## Points of judgement

| Lines on the return and their reasons | Share |
|---|---|
| One line defective, one line changed mind | 1 |
| One line not as pictured, one line arrived too late | 1 |
| Two lines not as pictured | 0.5 |
| One line too small | Nothing |
| One line unwanted gift, one line too large | Nothing |

Example (hypothetical): a shipping fee refunded of 7.95 with a shipping basis of 1 on a return whose only line is not as pictured gives 3.975, rounded half up to 3.98.
